acceptance: Each lane admission granted by file grain (not by package grain) records a signal with the pair, the cells and the later outcome, as the optimistic admission already does for reach-disjoint pairs.
evolve wave status (or a report verb) shows the fail rate of file-grain admitted pairs per wave.
fix: Record file-grain admissions and their outcomes so a fail rate exists before any finer grain is enabled.
summary: recordOptimistic fires only for pairs the reach rule holds (admission.go:133-143), so no signal records a file-grain admission and its fail rate is unmeasured. The reach-disjoint reference is 20.4% (43 of 211, 11-03 to 11-22).
title: Admission records file-grain pairs and their outcomes
